clips.title: Caught Badmouthing the Prince
grammar: 〜んじゃないか — asking for confirmation or speculating

lines.ja: へえー、誰が最低ゲスだって？
lines.en: Oh? Who did you say was the lowest scum?
lines.speaker: Kyouya

lines.ja: 陰でコソコソと人を貶めるとは、いいご身分になったもんだな。
lines.en: Sneaking around badmouthing someone behind their back... quite full of yourself, aren't you?
lines.speaker: Kyouya

lines.ja: そ、そんなことしてないよ！
lines.en: I-I didn't do anything like that!
lines.speaker: Erika

lines.ja: この状況でも嘘をつくとはな。
lines.en: To think you'd still lie in a situation like this.
lines.speaker: Kyouya

lines.ja: ご主人様に対する礼儀がなってないんじゃないか？
lines.en: Aren't you lacking proper manners toward your master?
lines.speaker: Kyouya

clips.title: Spin Three Times and Bark
grammar: 〜てやる — to do something for someone

lines.ja: これだけで許してやろうっていうんだ。
lines.en: I'm offering to forgive you with just that.
lines.speaker: Kyouya

lines.en: Quite generous of me, isn't it?
lines.speaker: Kyouya
